registration_procedure: 1. Registration authority (to be designated by the user as product owner) reviews each proposed row against the anchors above.

2. Authority signs the rows it accepts (signature field + reviewed_at) and appends them to reviewed_crosswalk in identity-crosswalk.json; schema version bumps to pai-core20k-crosswalk-v1.1 (signature field only, old fields unchanged).
3. Crosswalk status moves from BLOCKED_PENDING_ROW_LEVEL_VALIDATION to REVIEWED_PARTIAL only when at least one signed row exists; unsigned proposals change nothing.

4. A row is signed only for KUs whose other formal gates (scorer where applicable, manifest, isolation tests, license decision, e2e, human signoff) are closed. Signing is not a shortcut around the gates.
5. The formal Runtime file itself is not rewritten by registration; registration lives in the crosswalk + the signed overlay manifest.
